mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name AS client_name FROM bills b JOIN clients c ON b.client_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT b.*, c.name AS client_name FROM bills b JOIN clients c ON b.client_id = c.id WHERE b.client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY b.billing_year DESC, b.billing_month DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bills (client_id, meter_reading_id, billing_month, billing_year, consumption, price_per_kwh, price_per_ampere, subscription_fee_per_ampere, ampere_capacity, consumption_charge_usd, subscription_fee_usd, total_amount_usd, total_amount_lbp, exchange_rate, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{meterReadingId}, #{billingMonth}, #{billingYear}, #{consumption}, #{pricePerKwh}, #{pricePerAmpere}, #{subscriptionFeePerAmpere}, #{ampereCapacity}, #{consumptionChargeUsd}, #{subscriptionFeeUsd}, #{totalAmountUsd}, #{totalAmountLbp}, #{exchangeRate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE bills SET client_id = #{clientId}, meter_reading_id = #{meterReadingId}, billing_month = #{billingMonth}, billing_year = #{billingYear}, consumption = #{consumption}, price_per_kwh = #{pricePerKwh}, price_per_ampere = #{pricePerAmpere}, subscription_fee_per_ampere = #{subscriptionFeePerAmpere}, ampere_capacity = #{ampereCapacity}, consumption_charge_usd = #{consumptionChargeUsd}, subscription_fee_usd = #{subscriptionFeeUsd}, total_amount_usd = #{totalAmountUsd}, total_amount_lbp = #{totalAmountLbp}, exchange_rate = #{exchangeRate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bills SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
